facts.name: Sandra C. Upchurch
facts.assignment: Division53 Putnam circuit civil; also Flagler Division49. This review applies Putnam Division53 instructions only.

contact.contact_note: Bunnell mailing/office address retained. Putnam Division53 mailbox for Word orders, hearing materials and courtesy notices; scheduling uses kasmith mailbox. No Flagler Division49 route substituted.

procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Email JA for times, copy parties, coordinate and obtain confirmation; file notice within three days of confirmation and send courtesy notice to Division53. Cross-noticing requires permission and agreement.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Source requires Rule1.202 compliance and three conferral attempts including telephone communication, documented when unsuccessful.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Circulate first, then email Word orders to Division53, ordinarily within seven days after hearing. Competing orders not accepted; request hearing on impasse. Specialized exceptions remain in source.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Email hearing materials/case law to Division53; page9 literally says NO earlier/later than48Hours before hearing and rejects paper. Preserve that wording.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Source describes non-evidentiary matters OR hearings under60minutes as remote; separately requires nonjury trials, evidentiary hearings and60-minute-or-longer hearings in person unless agreed/approved. Zoom3863134530. Preserve overlapping scope; CMC/status conferences expressly Zoom.
procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Email JA with county, case number/name and subject, copying parties; omit JA from interparty messages requiring no action. Phone only if excused from email service.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: File motions and comply with conferral; submit hearing materials by designated Division53 email. No motion-specific litigation recipes extracted.

facts.summary: Putnam civil uses JA scheduling and Division53 email for Word orders and hearing materials; this differs from the saved Flagler proposed-order route.

review_scope.collected: Reused official profile original/timestamps; full nine-page Putnam Division53 procedure PDF collected.

Putnam Division53 general orders are Word by division email; saved Flagler Division49 general orders use existing-case portal. County/division differences retained, not generalized.
